description.blurb: GRIFEX, the Geo-cape Roic In-Flight performance Experiment, was a CubeSat technology validation test for the proposed GEO-CAPE mission.
description.more: GRIFEX advanced the technology required for future space-borne measurements of atmospheric composition from geostationary orbit that are relevant to climate change. The size of GRIFEX was three CubeSat units, or 30 x 10 x 10 cm.
